name: Quantinuum
description: Quantinuum is the world's largest integrated quantum computing company, formed in 2021 from the merger of Honeywell Quantum Solutions and Cambridge Quantum. Registered in the UK with European headquarters in Cambridge, the company builds trapped-ion quantum computers (H-Series) that hold the record for highest quantum volume. Quantinuum also develops quantum software including the open-source TKET compiler and quantum cybersecurity products.

products.name: H-Series Quantum Computers
products.description: Trapped-ion quantum processors holding world records for quantum volume, accessible via cloud and on-premise deployment

products.name: TKET
products.description: Open-source quantum computing compiler and optimization toolkit supporting multiple hardware backends

highlights: World's largest integrated quantum computing company, formed from Honeywell Quantum Solutions and Cambridge Quantum merger

news.title: Quantinuum and BMW Group expand into multi-year quantum computing partnership for advanced materials science
news.excerpt: The partnership extends BMW's use of successive Quantinuum H-series generations (Helios, Sol, Apollo) for molecular simulation and catalyst research, positioning it as one of the longest-sustained quantum-enterprise commitments.

news.title: Quantinuum files S-1 for Nasdaq IPO under ticker QNT
news.excerpt: Honeywell-backed Quantinuum publicly filed a Form S-1 with the SEC for a proposed IPO of Class A common stock on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under ticker QNT, with J.P. Morgan and Morgan Stanley as joint lead book-running managers.

news.title: Quantinuum publicly files S-1 registration statement for proposed Nasdaq IPO under ticker QNT
news.excerpt: Honeywell announced the public filing of Quantinuum's S-1 registration for a proposed Nasdaq IPO under ticker QNT. The filing disclosed 2025 revenue of $30.9M and a net loss of $192.6M. J.P. Morgan and Morgan Stanley are joint lead book-running managers.

news.title: Quantinuum Announces Collaboration with Synopsys to Advance Industrial Design with Quantum Computing
news.excerpt: Quantinuum and Synopsys launched a strategic collaboration to integrate quantum computing into engineering simulation workflows for computational fluid dynamics and electromagnetic simulation. The initiative aims to develop quantum-enabled solvers that improve accuracy and accelerate design cycles without requiring engineers to change existing processes.

news.title: Quantinuum Signs Letter of Intent with U.S. Department of Commerce to Advance Fault-Tolerant Trapped-Ion Quantum Computing
news.excerpt: Quantinuum signed a Letter of Intent with the U.S. Department of Commerce's CHIPS R&D Office for proposed federal funding to advance large-scale, fault-tolerant trapped-ion quantum computers and strengthen domestic manufacturing capabilities. GlobalFoundries and Monarch Quantum are expected to support the effort through semiconductor, advanced packaging, and integrated photonics technologies.

news.title: Quantinuum and bp Collaborate on Quantum Computing for Seismic Imaging
news.excerpt: Quantinuum and bp launched a quantum computing collaboration to improve seismic imaging and subsurface energy exploration using hybrid quantum-classical methods. The project builds on an earlier feasibility pilot and addresses computationally intensive wave-physics modelling that could theoretically achieve the same accuracy gains as classical doubling of resolution with far fewer resources.

news.title: Quantinuum files for IPO targeting USD 12.7B valuation on Nasdaq
news.excerpt: Quantinuum filed to raise $1.05 billion in its landmark IPO, offering shares at $45–$50 each for a fully diluted valuation of approximately $12.7 billion. The company will list on Nasdaq under ticker QNT — the first traditional IPO by a full-stack quantum computing company.

news.title: Quantinuum raises $1.68 billion in upsized Nasdaq IPO at $60 per share, valued at $14B+
news.excerpt: Quantinuum priced its IPO at $60 per share on June 3, 2026 — above the $53–$55 range — and raised $1.68 billion through 28 million Class A shares. Trading began on the Nasdaq Global Select Market (ticker: QNT) on June 4, opening at $68 per share. The IPO valued Quantinuum at over $14 billion.

news.title: Quantinuum raises $1.68 billion in upsized Nasdaq IPO, begins trading as QNT at $60 per share
news.excerpt: Quantinuum priced 28 million Class A shares at $60 each—above the $53–$55 target range—raising $1.68 billion in aggregate gross proceeds, with shares beginning Nasdaq trading on June 4 under ticker QNT. The IPO valued the company at approximately $15 billion and is the largest quantum computing public offering to date.

news.title: Microsoft and Quantinuum publish peer-reviewed Nature paper showing 800× quantum error correction improvement
news.excerpt: Using Microsoft's qubit-virtualization platform on Quantinuum trapped-ion hardware, the teams demonstrated logical error-rate reductions from 11× to 800× over physical baselines, with repeated mid-computation error correction across up to 12 logical qubits.

news.title: Sandia National Laboratories and Quantinuum validate 98-qubit Helios system with 99.9975% single-qubit fidelity
news.excerpt: A Nature paper co-authored by Sandia and Quantinuum reports 99.9975% single-qubit fidelity, 99.921% two-qubit fidelity, and 99.967% SPAM fidelity for the Helios QCCD trapped-ion system, confirming it operates in a regime that challenges contemporary supercomputers.

news.title: Quantinuum, Rolls-Royce, Riverlane and EPCC sign multi-year collaboration for quantum gas turbine fluid dynamics
news.excerpt: The four partners will develop hybrid quantum-classical workflows for computational fluid dynamics in gas turbine design, using Quantinuum's Helios platform, Riverlane's QEC stack, and EPCC's supercomputing resources. The work builds on prior Rolls-Royce and Riverlane research.

news.title: Quantinuum demonstrates first universal topological gate set using non-Abelian anyons, published in Nature
news.excerpt: Quantinuum with University of Chicago, Harvard, and Stony Brook demonstrated a universal gate set via non-Abelian anyon braiding and fusion on the 98-qubit H2 processor. Published in Nature, the approach could reduce reliance on resource-intensive magic state distillation.

news.title: Quantinuum to report Q2 2026 results on August 11 in inaugural earnings as public company
news.excerpt: Quantinuum scheduled its first public earnings report for August 11, 2026 — its inaugural disclosure since the $1.68 billion June IPO. Analyst expectations include approximately $7.8 million in Q2 revenue and a loss of $0.26 per share.
